title: _disposeShares passes an unguarded zero into the AMM adapter; production reverts on the zero-size swap while the test mock accepts it
description: ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._disposeShares passes sharesToSell into ammAdapter.swap without guarding sharesToSell == 0. CurveAMMAdapter.sol:129 enforces require(amountIn > 0, 'CurveAMMAdapter: amountIn must be > 0') — CORRECT DEFENSIVE CODE — so the call reverts. test/mocks/MockAMMAdapter.sol has no such guard, and EVERY market test, including all 13 new preview tests, runs against the mock. Two reachable paths to amountIn == 0: (1) vault.balanceOf(strategy) == 0 with principal still booked (post-emergencyWithdraw, or after another client drains the position per L-20); (2) convertToShares(gross) == 0 for a dust exit once the share price exceeds one underlying unit (probe at ~4x share price: netWanted 1 -> gross 2 -> shares 0).
impact: The normal exit path (withdraw / withdrawAsOwner) reverts for the affected client while principal stays booked; totalWithdrawal silently no-ops at :294. The test-fidelity half is the more important half: the mock is more permissive than production on EXACTLY the edge story-050 steers callers into, which is why a 13-test green suite proves nothing here.
attackPath: A client's shares reach zero while principal remains booked (post-emergencyWithdraw, or another client drained the commingled position), or a dust request floors convertToShares to zero.
previewExitFor returns netGuaranteed 0 but a POSITIVE gross, so the (0,0) sentinel does not fire (see L-24's fifth state).
CurveAMMAdapter.sol:129 reverts. The client's normal exit path is bricked.
The repo's test suite cannot see this because MockAMMAdapter accepts a zero-size swap.
recommendation: Add if (sharesToSell == 0) return 0; in ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._disposeShares (the originating defect), AND add the amountIn > 0 guard to MockAMMAdapter so the suite tests the production precondition. Do NOT 'fix' CurveAMMAdapter.sol:129 — that require is correct.
fingerprintBasisNote: FINGERPRINT BASIS RESCOPED per validity-check §1/§3 and the run brief: the primary contract:function is ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._disposeShares (the originating defect — it passes the unguarded zero), NOT CurveAMMAdapter.swap. Fingerprinting on the adapter would encode the defect as living in the adapter's CORRECT guard. CurveAMMAdapter.sol:129 and the mock divergence are carried as the mechanism.
mechanismSites: src/AMMAdapters/CurveAMMAdapter.sol:129 (the reverting require — correct defensive code, not the defect)
correctedRemedyStatement: STRUCK (severity-auditor, mandatory): the claim that there are 'two working escape hatches — not a permanent freeze' is FALSE and must not appear. relinquishPrincipal (AYieldStrategy.sol:695-716) writes down clientBalances and totalDeposited and moves ZERO assets — no transfer, no redeem, no swap. It is claim abandonment, not an escape hatch. The correct statement is: while the condition holds, no path returns underlying to the client. Remedy enumeration WAS run (withdraw/withdrawAsOwner revert; totalWithdrawal silently no-ops at :294; relinquishPrincipal :682 and relinquishPrincipalAsOwner :687 both succeed with no external call) — the enumeration is accurate, the characterisation of those calls as remedies was not.
escalationTrigger: Either write-down path being removed or owner-gated (in particular relinquishPrincipal ceasing to be client-callable) removes even the claim-abandonment exit => Medium.
